source_title: NHI / SaaS Integration 관리 정책 v0.1
chunk_text: NHI, Service Principal, App Registration, SaaS integration은 현재 운영 담당 owner를 가져야 한다. 퇴사자 또는 더 이상 담당자가 아닌 사용자는 owner로 남아 있으면 안 된다. active credential, token, key가 남아 있으면 사용 여부와 만료일을 확인하고, 불필요하면 revoke/delete, 사용 중이면 rotation 후 기존 값을 폐기한다. 민감 자산에 접근 가능한 NHI 권한은 필요성을 재검토하고 불필요한 접근은 회수한다.

Entra App Registration NHI residual access는 owner 확인, credential 상태 확인, 현재 담당 owner 재지정, credential revoke 또는 rotation, 민감 자산 접근 권한 재검토 순서로 조치한다. 모든 조치는 담당자 확인 후 수행하며 자동 revoke/delete를 전제로 하지 않는다. 조치 완료 후 수행한 조치, 담당자, 완료 여부를 기록한다. 근거 문서가 부족한 경우 임의 조치를 만들어내지 않는다.

퇴사자 owner가 남아 있던 App Registration이 active client secret으로 critical customer export storage에 접근하던 케이스에서 CRM 데이터 운영팀이 현재 owner를 재지정하고 client secret 사용 여부를 확인했다. 사용 중인 credential은 rotation 후 기존 값을 폐기했고, customer export storage 접근 권한은 필요성 검토 후 최소 권한으로 조정했다. 조치 결과는 완료이며 검증용 sample case다.

Review permissions granted to enterprise applications. The review uses the enterprise application permissions view to inspect delegated permissions, application permissions, consent status, and permission scope for an application.
Remove a password from an application. The request body requires keyId, the unique identifier for the password. A successful request returns 204 No Content.

Add a password or secret to an application. The request can include a passwordCredential with displayName, startDateTime, and endDateTime. The response returns a new passwordCredential and the generated secretText only at creation time.

Add an owner to an application. Application owners can be individual users, the associated service principal, or another service principal. The request body supplies the directory object identifier to assign as owner.

source_title: Assign Azure roles using the Azure portal
chunk_text: Azure role assignments define who has access to Azure resources, what they can do, and what scope the access applies to. Review role assignments at the relevant scope before changing access to a sensitive storage asset.
Remove Azure role assignments when access is no longer needed. Removing a role assignment revokes the access granted by that assignment at the selected scope.

source_title: Reviewing and modifying installed GitHub Apps
chunk_text: Review installed GitHub Apps, the permissions granted to them, and the repositories they can access. If an app is no longer needed, suspend or uninstall it to block access to resources owned by the account or organization.

source_title: Setting a personal access token policy for your organization
chunk_text: Organization owners can control access to resources by applying policies to personal access tokens. Policy options include restricting access, enforcing maximum lifetime, and requiring approval for fine-grained personal access tokens.

source_title: Control which third-party & internal apps access Google Workspace data
chunk_text: Control which third-party and internal apps access Google Workspace data. Administrators can review app access and manage whether apps are trusted, limited, or blocked.
